save_pkl_object: create a pickle file that serializes a Python object to disk at a given path
load_pkl_object: load a pickled Python object from a file path and return the deserialized object
safe_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint atomically using a temporary file then rename to avoid corruption
safe_checkpoint_archive: archive a checkpoint at regular intervals by copying the saved file with an index suffix
load_config: load a JSON config file and return nested dicts as DefaultDotDict objects for dot access
